mapper.select: SELECT a.bmt12_pc_history_id AS pc_history_id , a.bmt12_info_id AS info_id , c.ast01_class_tree_nm AS ast_class_tree_name , a.bmt12_start_date AS start_date , a.bmt12_host_nm AS host_name , a.bmt12_setting_date AS setting_date , a.bmt12_internal_ip AS internal_ip , a.bmt12_mac_address AS mac_address , a.bmt12_etc AS etc , a.bmt12_note AS note FROM bmt12_pc_history a LEFT OUTER JOIN bmt10_info b ON b.bmt10_info_id = a.bmt12_info_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree c ON c.ast01_class_tree_id = b.bmt10_ast_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.bmt12_info_id = #{infoId} AND a.bmt12_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY a.bmt12_start_date DESC

SELECT a.bmt12_pc_history_id AS pc_history_id , a.bmt12_info_id AS info_id , c.ast01_class_tree_nm AS ast_class_tree_name , a.bmt12_start_date AS start_date , a.bmt12_host_nm AS host_name , a.bmt12_setting_date AS setting_date , a.bmt12_internal_ip AS internal_ip , a.bmt12_mac_address AS mac_address , a.bmt12_etc AS etc , a.bmt12_note AS note FROM bmt12_pc_history a LEFT OUTER JOIN bmt10_info b ON b.bmt10_info_id = a.bmt12_info_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree c ON c.ast01_class_tree_id = b.bmt10_ast_class_tree_id WHERE a.bmt12_pc_history_id = #{pcHistoryId} AND a.bmt12_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bmt12_pc_history ( bmt12_pc_history_id, bmt12_company_id, bmt12_info_id , bmt12_start_date, bmt12_host_nm, bmt12_setting_date, bmt12_internal_ip, bmt12_mac_address, bmt12_etc, bmt12_note ) VALUES ( #{pcHistoryId}, #{companyId}, #{req.infoId} , #{req.startDate}, #{req.hostName}, #{req.settingDate}, #{req.internalIp}, #{req.macAddress}, #{req.etc}, #{req.note} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.bmt12_pc_history_id AS pc_history_id , a.bmt12_info_id AS info_id , a.bmt12_person_nm AS person_name , a.bmt12_start_date AS start_date , a.bmt12_internal_ip AS internal_ip , a.bmt12_mac_address AS mac_address , c.ast01_class_tree_nm AS ast_class_tree_name , a.bmt12_etc AS etc FROM ( SELECT * , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bmt12_info_id ORDER BY bmt12_start_date DESC) AS sort , COALESCE(f_emp_kor_nm( ( SELECT c.bmt11_person_id FROM bmt11_history c WHERE c.bmt11_info_id = bmt12_info_id AND c.bmt11_start_date <= #{baseDate} ORDER BY c.bmt11_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) ), '') AS bmt12_person_nm FROM bmt12_pc_history WHERE bmt12_start_date <= #{baseDate} ) a LEFT OUTER JOIN bmt10_info b ON b.bmt10_info_id = a.bmt12_info_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree c ON c.ast01_class_tree_id = b.bmt10_ast_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.bmt12_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.sort = 1 AND (COALESCE(a.bmt12_internal_ip,'')||COALESCE(a.bmt12_mac_address,'')||COALESCE(a.bmt12_host_nm,'')||COALESCE(a.bmt12_etc,'')||a.bmt12_person_nm||c.ast01_class_tree_nm) LIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY (CASE WHEN a.bmt12_person_nm = '' THEN '히' ELSE a.bmt12_person_nm END) COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , a.bmt12_start_date
